title: StockCast client evaluation
notice: Rate only features you have used. These responses describe client perceptions; technical performance and maintainability require separate engineering evidence.

items.text: The product, sales, and stock features support the retail tasks I need to complete.
The records shown by the system provide the information I need for my daily work.
The forecasting and restocking information is useful for decisions I am authorized to make.
The system works consistently when I perform my usual tasks.
When an action fails, the system gives enough information for me to recover or retry.
My saved records are available when I return to the system.
I can find the features I need through the system's navigation.
The labels, instructions, and forms make the required steps clear.
I can complete my daily tasks without unnecessary difficulty.
Pages and actions respond quickly enough for my normal work.
Saving and retrieving records takes an acceptable amount of time.
Forecasting and restocking information is available in time for my work.
